stories.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
stories.summary: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, keeps the harness thin: it only turns the agent's commands into robot motion. The agent drives a robot with two arms through one command line.

stories.title: LEV: Thinking Fast and Deep with Looped Decision Models
stories.summary: Decision models answer typed questions about an input with one probability per option, computed in a single forward pass without generating text.
